SEN.note: PI-SPI free-transfer rule applies from 2 November 2026; no licensing, in-service switch oversight or regional link stated as in service.
Free-transfer rule is a tariff rule; no redress or conduct rule stated.

facts.fact: Wave is integrated with Sendwave Wallet, which lets diaspora users hold USDC and withdraw it in CFA francs through Wave, according to economist Seydou Bocoum.
The state has chosen Orange Money as the distribution channel for certain public credit programmes, directing aid flows through it, according to economist Seydou Bocoum.
Wave dominates person-to-person mobile money with free deposits and withdrawals and transfers charged about 1%, and Orange Money is also in service, according to economist Seydou Bocoum.
Wave is used to pay for transport tickets (BRT, TER) and at public health establishments, according to economist Seydou Bocoum.
